scope: Appointment Calendar, Receipt Monitoring and Receipt Workbench; read-only UI inspection

environment.route_source: Receiving menu hrefs observed in the renewed Stage session, then confirmed in this temporary tab
environment.identity_limit: Retained Prod form identities label the work package. Calendar/Workbench Stage form IDs and implementation IDs were not read from Stage configuration metadata. Monitor URL explicitly contains 4106.

screens.name: Appointment Calendar

state_checks.finding: Calendar rendered dock-resource rows and hourly columns. Initial asynchronous shell was followed by loaded resource rows.
Day mode showed the current calendar day and hourly columns.
7 Days showed a seven-day range, date headers and hourly columns.
Previous moved the seven-day range backward by one week; Today became enabled.
Next returned to the current range, and a further Next moved forward one week.
Today restored the current seven-day range and became disabled; Day restored the single-day view.
Actions expanded to expose New. The menu was closed without invoking New.

The loaded current-day and seven-day views had dock resources but zero rendered appointment event nodes. This is a visible-state observation, not a claim that no appointments exist in other ranges or contexts.
Only Day and 7 Days view buttons were present; no Month control was exposed. No hidden view was invoked.
No visible appointment was available for a read-only preview or record-specific detail inspection in the reviewed ranges.
Creation, dragging, resizing, Edit and saving were outside this read-only pass.

unvisited_criteria: Appointment preview fields and selected-appointment action enablement
Record-specific View/Edit distinction and return path
Stage configuration metadata and event/service bindings
not_applicable_or_not_exposed: No Insight-style basic/advanced criteria or result-grid paging on the observed calendar surface
No Month view button exposed in this configuration

screens.name: Receipt Monitoring
screens.stage_form_id_independently_verified: 4106 is explicit in the runtime route; Stage configuration implementation not inspected

state_checks.finding: The root Receipt Dates chart, three total panels and three indicator tiles populated after initial loading. Numeric totals and chart values are omitted.
Receipt Dates was a breadcrumb link; no native select dropdown was present. Deeper breadcrumb slots were initially empty.

state_checks.action: Clicked the rendered Past due chart bar
state_checks.finding: Breadcrumb gained Receipt Date Past due, but the root chart remained displayed and the application raised the recorded server-error toast. No Receipt Type chart load was established.
Selecting Receipt Dates returned the breadcrumb to the root; the error toast was no longer visible on the subsequent state check.

state_checks.action: Clicked Insight after the root breadcrumb settled
state_checks.finding: The same server-error category appeared. URL remained /scale/monitors/4106 and no Receipt Insight criteria/grid loaded. No new tab was created.
The documented downstream hierarchy was not reached after the date drilldown error.
All three tile labels were observed; their destinations were not invoked after two equivalent server-error outcomes in monitor read-only branches.
Refresh was visible but not invoked. No warehouse change was made.

error.message: Internal server error. See the audit log for more information.
error.cause: unresolved; no audit log, network payload or server investigation performed
error.stop_rule: Stopped further monitor branch attempts after two equivalent server-error outcomes

unvisited_criteria: Receipt Type, Vendor Name and Purchase Order charts
Successful context propagation into Receipt Insight
Refresh behavior and empty chart states
Stage procedure/service bindings and effective indicator configuration
not_applicable_or_not_exposed: No Insight-style criteria pane or row grid on the observed monitor root
No native chart dropdown was exposed; chart bars and breadcrumbs provided the observed navigation surface

screens.name: Receipt Workbench

state_checks.finding: Receipt ID editor, receipt-lookup magnifier and populated Receiving Preference selector were present. No receipt was selected; preference values are omitted.
Actions expanded to expose Cancel. The menu was collapsed without invoking Cancel. New was separately visible and not invoked.
The Receiving Preference dropdown opened with existing options. No preference was changed; option names and values are omitted.

The enabled magnifier was clicked twice with intervening state checks. Neither attempt produced a visible lookup dialog, result-grid headers, new tab or route change. No explanatory error message was observed.
No legitimate selected-receipt context was obtained; Lines and Containers accordions, grids, paging, read-only details and conditional prompts remain unvisited.

Check In, Locate, Cancel transaction, New Line, Quick Scan, print/export, save/OK and other business operations were not invoked. Right-arrow and Plus controls were not used because no selected receipt context was established.

unvisited_criteria: Receipt lookup criteria, columns and selection return behavior
Selected receipt summary and receipt-line/container tabs or accordions
Action enablement under selected receipt/line/container context
Nested containers and conditional receiving prompts
not_applicable_or_not_exposed: Generic Insight basic/advanced criteria were not exposed on the workbench entry shell; the receipt lookup remains an unreviewed search branch

evidence_method.browser: Existing Brave browser 1; agent-created temporary tab only
evidence_method.observation: Rendered DOM snapshots, read-only DOM structural inspection and temporary monitor screenshots to verify the chart layout and visible server-error toast

limits: Stage is a distinct environment. Matching page labels/routes does not verify equivalence to retained Prod replica metadata, configuration, permissions or data.
Three loaded roots and reviewed exposed controls do not satisfy every applicable full-screen criterion. Full completion remains 0/3 for this bounded assignment.
Application error and no-visible-response categories are observed outcomes, not diagnoses of security, licensing or server causes.
Empty calendar event rendering applies only to the reviewed current context/ranges. It does not establish no appointments elsewhere.
No operation or permission checkpoint was validated by executing a business action. Existing six deferred mobile gaps and 0/34 deployment/timing freeze are unchanged.
